testcase.system-out: Scenario: Close and restore the model browser while editing a sketch ✔ Given a part document is open in the MCAD Software with a sketch being edited ✔ And the model browser is docked on the left ✔ When the user selects the browser tab's close control ✔ Then the model browser is hidden ✔ And the sketch viewport extends into the freed space ✔ And a panel-add control remains at the upper left of the workspace ✔ When the user opens the panel-add control ✔ Then the panel list offers Model Browser ✔ When the user selects Model Browser ✔ Then the model browser returns to the left ✔ And the browser tree and sketch viewport remain visible
